d18: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d18: 🕯️ Larry Foster is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d18: What Larry kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.

d18: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Jose blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d18: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.

d18: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d18: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
